summary: Implemented the Tabs feature in the generated repo, without committing and without running any code or tests. Changes: new src/textual/widgets/tabs.py (Tab, Tabs, TabsRenderable); UnderlineBar gains clickable_ranges (before width) and yields one Text with click spans last; Opacity now merges the blended color into each segment's existing style; layout resolver needed no change because Edge already declares min_size. Added docs/reference/tabs.md, sandbox/tabs_demo.py and tabs_demo.css, three appended underline tests, and tests/widgets/__init__.py plus tests/widgets/test_tabs.py. Tests are unverified because I was asked not to run code. Choices: bar position is a full-list index mapped to displayed tabs by name; first-character search applies only to single-character keys.
